CLOUD FIXER seat for roster group R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (round 2 of PR #2605). Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own at the code tip `git fetch origin handoff/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry` (6712698a), merging origin/main in (now cd4aaed44, v7.0.3).
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry, then write the PR body (headings per .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-nightly-pyspy-retry <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry. That second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 2 of PR #2605 (R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY; PR head 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73, code 6712698a). Round 1 is BLOCKED mutation-vacuous: read `git fetch origin review/2605 && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` (f00094d17). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Do:
1. Pin the real lane's py-spy cut. LoopHeartbeat's `spy_timeout` default must be PY_SPY_TIMEOUT_S: drive one stub try with no spy_timeout passed, or check the signature. Pin the body's stated whole-control bound, HB_CONTROL_TRIES*(HB_CONTROL_HOLD_S+HB_CONTROL_REST_S), under the figure the body states. Mutants X2 (PY_SPY_TIMEOUT_S=25.0) and X5 (default spy_timeout=30.0) must go red, and so must X1 (the rest sleep replaced with pass) and X3 (HB_CONTROL_TRIES=2): pin each or state in the body why its value is free. Add X1, X2, X3 and X5 as named mutants in your harness and re-run it. Quote the RESULT.
2. Fix the code comment at tests/nightly_ha.py:289-291. State that the fresh-spin retry was measured not to rescue a real-HA hang (F7), and what it is kept for.
3. RESIDUAL OWNER: decision O-4 (orchestrator, mandate 6329234399). The per-process hang moves to a new group R10-NIGHTLY-HB-RESPAWN (after R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY): a container respawn on an all-tries py-spy timeout. It is being added to the roster on handoff/audit-r10-roster. Route the residual carry there with `Carry: R10-NIGHTLY-HB-RESPAWN`, not to this PR's own group. Do not build the respawn in this PR.
4. Correct the "every bound is under HB_HANG_S" sentence to what is pinned. Re-take every figure, and rewrite the whole body.
Time box 60 min. Return on handoff/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry plus body_push.sh r10-nightly-pyspy-retry.
